## Description
Provide a clear description of the modifications made, their purpose, and target issues.

## Related Issue(s)
Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change
Please delete options that are not relevant:
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Code cleanup / Refactoring (non-breaking)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification & Testing
How was this change verified?
- [ ] Checked linter clean (`uv run ruff check` / `pnpm lint`)
- [ ] Executed automated tests (`uv run pytest` / `pnpm test`)
- [ ] Verified build succeeds (`pnpm build`)
- [ ] Manual browser/console sanity checks

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly.
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings.
